system.abilityReq: Adamant Circle Sorcery / Obsidian Circle Necromancy, Occult 6, Essence 6
system.description: As Emerald Circle Feedback (Power 3), save that this power works against the Adamant Circle as the earlier version does against Emerald, automatically preventing the use of Emerald and Sapphire Circle sorcery as well as thaumaturgy. An alternate version similarly affects necromancy of the Void Circle and below.
